title: A wonderful tour of Seville Cathedral with Sofia
text:
We had a wonderful tour with Sofia and would definitely recommend her.

She was friendly, knowledgeable and very well prepared. The tour felt truly tailor-made, taking into account our interests as well as the fact that we were travelling with children aged 6 and 14.

She actually turned the visit into a game for our six-year-old and managed to keep him engaged for the whole 1.5-hour tour – quite an achievement!

title: Fantastic
text: Sofia was a great tour guide who was so helpful and knowledgeable and made our experience in Sevilla a great one.
author: michaelmS1909OL

title: Cathedral tour with Sofia—amazing
text: Sofia was amazing—very informative and knowledgeable. She was also very helpful, making other recommendations for our visit. We especially enjoyed her personal stories and perspectives. She was particularly attentive in assuring an excellent tour as well as an overall excellent experience in Seville!!
author: megandV520OI

title: Fantastic walking tour with an awesome local expert
text:
We had a fantastic tour of the Maria Louisa park, the former Jewish quarter, the Seville Cathedral and to the top of the Giralda. 
Sofia was so knowledgeable and engaging, such a warm helpful person who went out of her way to also point out local hidden things along our walk. 
It was a privilege to be learning from someone with such a deep historical knowledge of the area.
We thoroughly recommend her tour.
author: G9178WMroberta

title: Great experience with Sofia.
text: Sofia was great - her knowledge made our tour excellent and memorable. The Cathedral can be overwhelming- she kept us focused and made it fun. Thank you Sofia.
author: johnpW4991YB

title: Wonderful Private Tour!
text: It is so helpful to have such a knowledgeable guide to curate an experience through this huge Cathedral. There is so much history and so many layers, that we would have been lost without her. Sofia showed us a bit of the detail in a succinct tour and also gave us more tips on what to explore next. Thank you so much for your help.
author: Ryan_K

title: Great tours
text: We did two tours with Sofia - the Cathedral and the Alcazar. They were both excellent. Sofia was interesting and engaging and had a wealth of knowledge about the history. For the cathedral tour she arrived really early so that she could get the first spot in line so we would have the best experience in spite of the crowds.
author: KathrynL1277

title: Sofia was a great tour...
text: Sofia was a great tour guide! The Cathedral is an amazing and immense site and Sofia really told a great story, hitting all the highlights and giving you a great sense of the place. She was really responsive and helpful beyond just the tour with her recommendations around Seville. Definitely recommend!
author: Andrew_S

title: A short but sweet taste of Seville with the help of a fantastic guide
text:
Sofia was such a wonderful and accommodating guide! We are a family of 5 from the Philippines, and I had contacted her quite last minute — about a week before our arrival. Still, she did her best to find time for us in her schedule as well as make recommendations for the times she wasn’t free. I really appreciated the communication and tips in the days leading up to our tour.

title: An Unforgettable Experience
text: This was the first private tour my husband and I have ever taken and Sofia made it a very special experience.  She was both personable and professional and made our trip to the cathedral one we will not soon forget.  We highly recommend her services.
